slides.alt_text: The BSB text of Gen 49:10: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the staff from between his feet, until Shiloh comes and the allegiance of the nations is his.
slides.body: “The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the staff from between his feet, until Shiloh comes and the allegiance of the nations is his.”
slides.heading: Gen 49:10

slides.alt_text: Slide 1: A predicted name for Jesus?
slides.body: The BSB reads “until Shiloh comes.” John 17:3 calls Jesus the one God sent. The proposed fulfilment equates Shiloh with “One Sent.”
slides.heading: A predicted name for Jesus?

slides.body: A coming ruler fits a messianic reading, and the audit traces the “sent” interpretation to the Vulgate’s rendering. Christians can connect that translation tradition with Jesus’s mission from God.
slides.heading: How the connection arises

slides.alt_text: Slide 3: The equation is not established
slides.body: Shiloh is disputed, and “sent” is not a secure Hebrew meaning. Other readings concern tribute or rightful possession. John neither names Jesus Shiloh nor cites Genesis, so it does not establish fulfilment of a predicted name.
slides.heading: The equation is not established
